mapper.sql: operation_id, request_id, administrator_user_id, payload_hash, status, claim_token, lease_expires_time, total_count, processed_count, result_json, replay_count, last_error, version, created_time, updated_time, completed_time
mapper.insert: insert into oa_sign_task_hard_delete_operation ( request_id, administrator_user_id, payload_hash, status, claim_token, lease_expires_time, total_count, processed_count, result_json, replay_count, last_error, version, created_time, updated_time ) values ( #{requestId}, #{administratorUserId}, #{payloadHash}, #{status}, #{claimToken}, #{leaseExpiresTime}, #{totalCount}, #{processedCount}, #{resultJson}, 0, null, 0, sysdate(), sysdate() ) on duplicate key update operation_id = last_insert_id(operation_id), replay_count = replay_count + 1, updated_time = sysdate()
mapper.select: select from oa_sign_task_hard_delete_operation where request_id = #{requestId} limit 1 for update
mapper.update: update oa_sign_task_hard_delete_operation set status = 'PROCESSING', claim_token = #{claimToken}, lease_expires_time = #{leaseExpiresTime}, last_error = null, version = version + 1, updated_time = sysdate() where operation_id = #{operationId} and version = #{version} and ( status = 'RETRY' or ( status = 'PROCESSING' and (lease_expires_time is null or lease_expires_time <= #{dueTime}) ) )

update oa_sign_task_hard_delete_operation set status = 'COMPLETED', processed_count = #{processedCount}, result_json = #{resultJson}, claim_token = null, lease_expires_time = null, last_error = null, completed_time = sysdate(), version = version + 1, updated_time = sysdate() where operation_id = #{operationId} and status = 'PROCESSING' and version = #{version} and claim_token = #{claimToken} and processed_count = #{processedCount} and processed_count = total_count

update oa_sign_task_hard_delete_operation set status = 'RETRY', claim_token = null, lease_expires_time = null, last_error = #{lastError}, version = version + 1, updated_time = sysdate() where operation_id = #{operationId} and status = 'PROCESSING' and version = #{version} and claim_token = #{claimToken}
